config.method: One ten-epoch trajectory per seed; capture weights at seven and ten
config.primary_metric: INT8 development-test accuracy; sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
config.model_retention: No per-seed model files; weights and exports used in memory only
config.deployment_candidate: Unchanged; no seed selected by its individual test score
config.limitations: Training variability on a fixed development benchmark, not new-data uncertainty

summary.accuracy_units: fraction; multiply by 100 for percent or percentage-point differences
